title: Entitlement-constrained VCF 9.1 greenfield architecture and estate migration
prompt:
Build the deployment architecture package for the ORD1 VMware Cloud Foundation project. This is an architecture deliverable, not a narrative report. Use `fixtures/greenfield-scenario.json` and `fixtures/estate-inventory.json` as the scenario inputs, and conform the generated artifacts to `schemas/greenfield-architecture.schema.json` and `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`.

Before implementing, research Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, licensing, and upgrade-path information applicable to the supplied component combinations. Record the sources consulted in `research_sources.json` as a JSON array. Each entry must identify the publisher, page title, URL, consultation date, and the compatibility or upgrade claim checked.

Implement a package named `vcf_architect` using only the Python standard library. Export `build_architecture(scenario, inventory)` from the package. It accepts the two decoded input mappings and returns the complete architecture mapping. Also provide `python3 -m vcf_architect --scenario PATH --inventory PATH --output PATH`, writing deterministic UTF-8 JSON. The package must derive its result from the supplied mappings rather than opening fixed input paths internally.

Commit the generated result as `architecture.json`. Its top-level members are exactly `artifactVersion`, `greenfield`, and `migrationPlan`, with `artifactVersion` equal to `1.0`. `greenfield` must conform to `schemas/greenfield-architecture.schema.json`. Its `sddcSpec` is the deployable greenfield `SddcSpec`: it must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract, use the supported 9.1 BOM, express all eight supplied hosts and the supplied DNS, NTP, VLAN, IP-range, DVS, NSX, vSAN ESA, management-service, naming, and `deploymentDesign` inputs, and preserve the availability and capacity calculations in machine-readable fields. Select a supported topology that meets workload and N+1 requirements without exceeding either entitlement. Record every supported topology excluded by that decision and its computed host, core, and raw-vSAN requirements with the applicable entitlement reason codes.

`migrationPlan` must conform to `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`. Starting from every component in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`, produce a single ordered sequence of supported version transitions that reaches the VCF 9.1 target for every component. Every step names the inventory component id and current component/version, its target component/version, and the gates attached to that transition. Respect all transition prerequisites and do not skip the mandatory intermediate release.

Do not modify `tests/`, `fixtures/`, `schemas/`, `specifications/`, or `pyproject.toml`. Run `python3 -I -B tests/verify.py` from the repository root.
reference_patch_apply: git apply -p1 --directory=files reference_fix.patch (from the seed root)
